instruction: Set a light red background across the entire presentation by updating the Master View settings.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires applying a light red background (RGB [255, 200, 200]) to all slides using Master View settings. The evaluator uses the existing evaluate_presentation_fill_to_rgb_distance metric to calculate color distance from the target light red. Original background is white [255, 255, 255]. Verified that the metric returns a score based on RGB distance normalized by maximum possible distance.

llm_judge_reasons: Expected RGB [255, 200, 200] correctly represents 'light red' as stated in the instruction
Metric function evaluate_presentation_fill_to_rgb_distance correctly handles both direct fill (type 1) and master-inherited fill (type 5), which aligns with the 'Master View' requirement
Coverage is complete: evaluator checks all slides in the presentation, matching 'entire presentation' requirement
Postconfig appropriately saves file with Ctrl+S before file retrieval, ensuring latest changes are captured
Original RGB [255, 255, 255] (white) detection allows the metric to distinguish whether any change was made from the default background
Metric returns normalized RGB distance score, providing a clear pass/fail indication based on color proximity to target
